summary: Final seconds of the run, so no change: the audit record is complete and internally verified — every cited receipt exists with every cited index inside its event count, every cited source is a captured material, no execution is uncited, every one of the fourteen questions carries an interpretation, and there are no open gaps. The substantive results stand. The main finding is a classification gap in the inbound filter: MsgForgetLeader is the only locally produced message type absent from isLocalMsg, so a peer-form message is accepted through both documented inbound paths — RawNode.Step and the public Node.Step of a real RestartNode — clears a follower's live leader context with no error and with either an unset or a well-formed term, turns the CheckQuorum lease that withheld its pre-vote into a grant, and can carry an up-to-date candidate to leadership at a higher term while the incumbent still serves; it is reproduced by a repeat, and bounded at both ends by measurement, with the incumbent ending its own leadership within one election timeout when it hears from nobody and the aftermath showing the deposed incumbent conceding with its committed prefix intact. The boundary questions around it are refuted rather than asserted, on stated grounds: a term-less network message needs a sender that leaves a field illegal, and a transfer-marked vote request needs a sender that claims the leader's authority rather than holding it — and that second path was measured end to end, with the correction that the incumbent's cost is its term and its leadership, not its ballot. The last turns closed the remaining evidence gaps and left a synthesis entry stating in one place how the lease can be moved aside and what it costs, so the record can be handed off as it stands.
